name.text: Finding the length of a ladder

questiontext.text:
A ladder rests against a vertical wall. The ladder reaches a height of {@height@} metres up the wall and makes an angle of {@theta@} degrees with the horizontal ground.

Use the information to calculate the length of the ladder.

[[jsxgraph]] /* Retrieve the STACK variables */ var theta = {#theta#}; var h = {#height#}; /* Convert the angle to radians and calculate horizontal distance */ var angleRad = theta * Math.PI / 180; var x = h / Math.tan(angleRad); /* Initialise the JSXGraph board */ var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-3, h + 2, x + 2, -2], axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, keepaspectratio: false }); /* Define the triangle vertices */ var A = board.create('point', [0, 0], { name: 'A', fixed: true, size: 3 }); var B = board.create('point', [0, h], { name: 'B', fixed: true, size: 3 }); var C = board.create('point', [x, 0], { name: 'C', fixed: true, size: 3 }); /* Draw the wall */ board.create('segment', [A, B], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 3 }); /* Draw the ground */ board.create('segment', [A, C], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 3 }); /* Draw the ladder */ board.create('segment', [B, C], { strokeColor: '#2563eb', strokeWidth: 3 }); /* Draw the right-angle marker */ var s = Math.min(x, h) * 0.06; board.create('segment', [[s, 0], [s, s]], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 1 }); board.create('segment', [[s, s], [0, s]], { strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 1 }); /* Label the angle at C */ board.create('text', [x - 0.55, 0.18, theta + '°'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 16, strokeColor: '#2563eb' }); /* Label the vertical height */ board.create('text', [-2.7, h / 2, 'Height = ' + h + ' m'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 13, strokeColor: 'black' }); /* Label the ground */ board.create('text', [x / 2, -1, 'Ground'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 13, strokeColor: 'black' }); /* Label the ladder */ board.create('text', [0.45 * x, 0.58 * h, 'Ladder = ?'], { fixed: true, fontSize: 13, strokeColor: '#2563eb' }); board.update(); [[/jsxgraph]]

Calculate the length of the ladder.

[[input:ans1]]

[[validation:ans1]]

[[feedback:prt1]]

Instructions: Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.

Hint: Use the sine ratio:

\(\sin\theta=\dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}\)

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

We are given:

  • Angle with the ground: \({@theta@}^\circ\)
  • Vertical height: \({@height@}\text{ m}\)

We need to calculate the length of the ladder.

Step 1: Identify the appropriate trigonometric ratio.

The vertical height is opposite the given angle, while the ladder is the hypotenuse. Therefore, we use the sine ratio:

\(\sin\theta=\dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}\)

Step 2: Substitute the known values.

\(\sin({@theta@}^\circ)=\dfrac{@height@}{L}\)

Step 3: Rearrange to make the ladder length the subject.

\(L=\dfrac{@height@}{\sin({@theta@}^\circ)}\)

Step 4: Calculate the length.

\(L\approx {@ta1@}\text{ m}\)

Final Answer:

\(\boxed{L={@ta1@}\text{ m}}\)

Ensure that your calculator is in degree mode.
